biggest_catch: Payouts rise with each referral ($250 for the first, up to $750 for the fifth and beyond), but the escalating tiers reset every January 1st and only count friends who join within the same calendar year; bonuses pay the day after the new member completes all requirements, which can take up to 120 days.
catches: Tiered per-referral bonuses within one calendar year: $250 (1st), $400 (2nd), $500 (3rd), $600 (4th), $750 (5th and each after), up to 10 per calendar year
Tiers reset each January 1st; higher payouts require all referred members to join within the same calendar year
Referred member gives the referrer's unique promo code at account opening, then must meet membership eligibility and all qualification requirements (up to 120 days)
Cannot be combined with any other Stanford FCU promotional offers
Invalid if the referred member had a Stanford FCU account closed within the last two years
Stanford FCU employees, family members, and volunteers are not eligible; no bonuses for members in the same household
Stanford FCU may modify or cancel the program without notice

steps: Generate your unique promo code in your Stanford FCU account (Open & Apply → Refer a Friend)
Share your promo code with friends and family
Friend joins Stanford FCU and provides your promo code at account opening
Friend meets all membership eligibility and qualification requirements (up to 120 days)
Your bonus ($250-$750 based on your referral count this calendar year) is deposited the day after they qualify
